open_questions: Of it remains provisionally earth; ocean-versus-stream carrier of glimpses is grammatically ambiguous. Odia makes oceans the carrier; keep query rather than asserting a different attachment.
Hindi female speaker and male addressee remain provisional. Source bunds retained as embankments without inventing geography or an event.
reason: Make unabsorbed passage grammatical without assigning a new deliberate agent to the rain.
tradeoff: Samaye bina carries failure to be taken into the saturated skin in idiomatic Hindi; preserves flow and later reason, no literal biological explanation.
